Bug_Details: Object serialized in Bundle may have been flattened to base type.
Bug_Explanation: The code demonstrates a scenario where an object of a derived type is serialized into a container. When deserialized, it is cast to a base type, which may cause issues when attempting to cast it back to the derived type. This can lead to a ClassCastException if the object is not correctly handled, simulating a common mistake in deserialization operations.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug_TriggerBug method calls the showBug method from the BundleDeserializationExample class, which attempts to cast a BaseType back to a DerivedType after deserialization. This triggers a ClassCastException because the object was serialized and deserialized through the base class, causing the JUnit test to fail.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results indicate that the test passed successfully (OK), which means the ClassCastException was not thrown during the test execution. Therefore, the bug was not triggered.
